pages.title: Hilbert's Hotel Key
pages.text: A brass key with a tag that always reads one number higher than the last time I looked. Hilbert's Hotel has infinitely many rooms, all full, and still has space for a new guest: everyone just moves up by one. The key is warm, as if someone has only now handed it over.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found it in a drawer of the infinite hotel, and later prised more from the hands of the Bellhops who shuffle guests from room n to room n+1. The tag changed while I was reading it, which was my first proof that the hotel was taking its own rule seriously.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Hilbert Bellhop.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Hilbert Hotel chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Inaccessible Cardinal.
